summary: LN-031 retest (backend+frontend). Backend: original LN-031 4/4, new extra suite 6/6 (meta can_paper_check per role, designer ownership 403, md 403, archived 400, missing 404, 6x concurrent paper click -> 1 history/1 timeline, uncheck recorded w/o status/acc change, OD-linked design ACC race admin+manager -> exactly one 200 + one 409/400, exactly 1 approve timeline + exactly 1 auto-proofing sample, chain.review.object/object_label + customer_decisions[].object/object_label). LN-030 regression 25/25 + 6/6. Frontend (static build): designer checks/unchecks Print paper in Design Studio Summary -> info 'dicentang <name> · <time>', uncheck shows 'dibatalkan ...', status stays Draf, no API errors; foreign design -> 403 banner shown properly. Special Order detail (sales): od-customer-approval title shows 'objek: Desain (ACC PIC)', od-customer-reminder visible before ACC, ACC via UI -> reminder gone, chip od-customer-decision-object-<id> = 'Desain (ACC PIC)', status chip shown. All features in scope work; only minor UX issues + one pre-existing business-logic concern.

minor.issue: transition() $set replaces the whole 'versions' array built from a stale read, so a paper check written between the read and the update (same ms window) is lost from versions[].paper/paper_history (timeline event stays). Low probability; fix with positional updates (versions.$.acc/score) instead of a full array $set.
status_history note is always 'Pelanggan ACC sample — ...' even when the object is 'design' (Desain (ACC PIC)). Should use object_label.

For a printing OD, once the PIC approves the design, review is 'ready' with object 'design' even though the auto-proofing sample (e.g. KSC/SMP-00022) is still Draf. Sales can then record customer ACC and the OD goes to 'Terkonfirmasi', skipping proofing kain. Needs an owner decision: when an open proofing sample exists, should the object be 'proofing' (and not ready until it is decided)?

ui_bugs.issue: Timeline shows raw event keys 'paper_check' / 'paper_uncheck' with no Indonesian label, and they are counted under the 'Status & keputusan' filter even though they are not decisions

Checkbox is enabled for a designer on another designer's design because canPaper = meta.can_paper_check (role-level only). Clicking it gives a 403 banner. Should also check ownership, like the backend's assert_design_writer.

integration_issues.issue: The panel first renders 'Belum ada sample yang diputus...' (od-customer-not-ready) from the list row data that has no chain, then switches to ready/reminder after the detail loads. This is a brief wrong-state flash.

action_items: (Low) Add human labels for paper_check/paper_uncheck in the design history renderer, and consider moving them out of the 'Status & keputusan' filter
(Low) Disable the paper checkbox in the UI when a designer is not the owner/assignee
(Low) Use object_label in the customer-decision status_history note instead of the hard-coded 'sample'
(Low) Use positional updates in transition() so a concurrent paper check is not overwritten
(Owner decision) Printing OD: should customer ACC on 'Desain (ACC PIC)' be allowed while the auto-proofing sample is still open?
critical_code_review_comments: design_studio_service.py is 746 lines (>700). Consider splitting the paper/hold helpers into their own module.
transition(): the atomic guard {id,status,version} is correct; the side effects (dsr sync, on_design_approved, notify) only run for the winner. Good.
set_paper(): the $elemMatch guard on paper.checked makes it idempotent under concurrency (verified 6 parallel calls).
assert_design_writer lets anyone through when created_by_id is empty and no request is linked (pre-existing).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of scoped flows (minor UX issues noted)

seed_data_creation: Temporary TEST_ designs (dsgn_TEST_ui31_*) and OD TEST_UI31_OD (SORD-261018-0003) with DSR/proofing sample were created for UI testing and then deleted. The pytest suites clean up after themselves.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the pytest files one at a time with -n0. The OD-linked ACC race test builds the OD via API (parent_product + printing -> approve -> items[0].design_request_id), inserts a gallery design with request_id and links design_requests.design_id/gallery_ids. Frontend is a static build: changes need scripts/rebuild_frontend.sh.
